usedFor: EmailOctopus holds contacts and campaigns, and Dropbox saves a file from a web link through “Upload File to Dropbox”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Campaign Created” in EmailOctopus, then “Upload File to Dropbox” in Dropbox
bestTemplate.why: Each new campaign can trigger a saved copy of a file, with a choice of how to handle existing files.

watchOut: “Upload File to Dropbox” saves from a public web link, so the file must be reachable at that link.
